chapter.heading: Psalm 113The Lord Exalts the Humble.
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord! (Hallelujah!)Praise, O servants of the Lord, Praise the name of the Lord.

Blessed be
the name of the Lord From this time forth and forever.

From the
rising of the sun to its setting The name of the Lord is to be praised [with awe-inspired reverence].

The Lord
is high above all nations, And His glory above the heavens.

¶Who is
like the Lord our God, Who is enthroned on high,

Who humbles
Himself to regard The heavens and the earth? [Ps 138:6; Is 57:15]

He raises
the poor out of the dust And lifts the needy from the ash heap,

That He
may seat them with princes, With the princes of His people.

He makes
the barren woman live in the house As a joyful mother of children.Praise the Lord! (Hallelujah!)
